posts.caption: Another look into our Saturday filled with good vibes! The waves were so large, so we transitioned to volleyball, soccer, and laying in the sunshine.
This past Saturday! With the biggest swell of the year hitting the coastline this weekend, it was important to educate our Surf Club students of the importance of beach safety.
Salinas Surf Club Volunteer Spotlight. He’s been showing up for our surf club for the past 4 years, sharing his love for surfing and helping our students build confidence in the water.
Our last surf session of the year is this Saturday at Wharf 2!! So grateful for another year filled with waves, smiles, and community.
Surfboard Raffle!!! 100% of fundraiser proceeds will go towards getting our students out in the water and surfing.
Salinas Surf Club Sponsor Spotlight. They’ve hosted our annual fundraiser each year, helped us with fundraising promotion, and have hosted club lunches for our students!
Salinas Surf Club Volunteer Spotlight. Thank you for continuing to show up for our club and our students.
